result.keyword: What's the best HR software for a small company?
result.markdown:
For most small companies, **Gusto is my top recommendation** if you want payroll, employee onboarding, benefits, and basic HR management in one easy-to-use platform.

However, the best choice depends on whether you need a complete HR system, payroll management, or more advanced employee management.

Here are the platforms I'd put on your shortlist for 2026.

## Best HR software for small businesses

![Gusto Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ftD0qJ1yBSoWTtDEs2sOfDQ7-65e7zEzHy-HIAb3bqFrmNGGc0DyUX0E7CdY1ulVg_3Q5_8qLVi4LE1wqaQS_JVEpU9pxbwM6Kz6OYgPCcQM2vYw21WPy-MCNW4IYnmmdNSrLtuLoIyJLYtPy5hO5B7jEV7698TKyyKP6yzFWMR7Sgf2P81H8Y7V-Tx23IPn?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Gusto**

(Best overall for small businesses)

- Payroll and tax filing
- Employee onboarding and document storage
- Benefits administration
- Time off and employee self-service

**Starting price\:** Approximately \$49/month + \$6/employee.

Website: [Gusto](https://gusto.com/)

---

![BambooHR Pricing Tiers & Costs (Updated for 2026)](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/lfGhQCVpJQbVf41B3vtRX6UWHPJMlOVTkV5Lya9yPIISkiwns_htURwqMmTW1XKVeOlzwGtSwMoAy6xHZfLSsDRbj_k8ukNFpuVVacxjpUmUJ8OulZgM7uKaXXq0t7AgyNBI0lwdAtl5FOEEJtWnohYZhANModEpYKzGNdOVx23nOO8vpFEk1sa8a024E67p?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. BambooHR**

(Best dedicated HR platform)

- Employee records and organizational charts
- Onboarding and offboarding
- Performance reviews
- PTO and employee management
- HR reporting

**Starting price\:** Pricing varies; small-company minimums can apply.

Website: [BambooHR](https://www.bamboohr.com/)

---

![#1 Workforce Management System - Gong Collective](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/6qeGsApk2jIdFyoxTSygvm7DexVcRwsdAMy-654nhQtsS9qblmlI3_rlyRsZYYkAZppbxudJa7sWDHqPbmVa4ApGBm0HQ-Ug4zK3bKSWGz9BUa-Xw79ufdKKevGKKSwz6wXnJf7tmhQAv7jp_2IhhmpGMf4r2A4gxIyk--T1g2YbjSd8UAKymDETIYyyT6m-?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Rippling**

(Best for automation and growth)

- HR, payroll, and benefits
- Employee onboarding and offboarding
- IT access and software management
- Automated workflows
- Integrations with other business systems

**Starting price\:** Approximately \$8/employee + base fee.

Website: [Rippling](https://www.rippling.com/)

---

![Introducing Zoho People 5.0 | Streamlined & secure HR software](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/N2tyoCYDXo_2X8HD_5-SWCfDBpBrfnJxvS27zq0luRDcSBxvb5ksF8GIcSrns-PjyFB81AcM6r9iE-CSXiUONYeUFYVq66I46rVVwsJXPLlWkRDDpj17x51dneUMDGMOeIbB1fDSAq7EtcK5moqwY1sb0xYonWwdnsoigFpIV0zzd1uQR8FzhmzsLBPdP8qA?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Zoho People**

(Best budget option)

- Employee database
- Attendance and leave management
- Performance management
- Custom HR workflows

**Starting price\:** Approximately \$1.50/employee/month on entry-level paid plans.

Website: [Zoho People](https://www.zoho.com/people/)

---

![RUN Powered by ADP® Payroll Software | ADP](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/RpGcHs-PaNOo1cKIxFpsEQuw9zfE12TEYccICxkqqcA3CO2NvRfDtJbCfHi2Nr0YYYblVCChq2UL52-TzeRVq7RXCW745y0Vk8MEKZHTp113Xnj3kep_aCHaeYLzdBWH7veM5Y6_lQASKp9n8UaI6GWb3lo9RY4lH6rVom7VA1O8HweTnOpsYnwKG4YX01TL?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. ADP RUN**

(Best for payroll support)

- Payroll processing and tax administration
- HR and compliance resources
- Employee onboarding
- Benefits and time-management options

**Starting price\:** Custom quote.

Website: [ADP RUN](https://www.adp.com/what-we-offer/products/run-powered-by-adp.aspx)

These recommendations reflect current 2026 comparisons. ## Which one should you choose?

| Your company's priority | My recommendation |
|--------|--------|
| Payroll + basic HR | Gusto |
| Complete employee management | BambooHR |
| HR + IT + automation | Rippling |
| Lowest-cost HR management | Zoho People |
| Payroll support and compliance | ADP RUN |


**My advice\:** If you're a company with 5–50 employees, I'd start by comparing Gusto, BambooHR, and Rippling. Don't pay for a complicated enterprise HR system unless you actually need it.
